testcase.name: M7-only compatibility: without a contributor the hooked driver admits exactly as M7 (cap counts rings only)
Per-player M8 cap: a third M8 kind is refused at 2 even below the global cap; replacement still allowed
Rings first, then M8: at cap 2, two rings refuse a new aura; a ring replacement still succeeds
Every activation order of a mixed set reaches exactly the cap and refuses the next start, whatever its kind
M8 first, then rings: M8 effects count toward the ring path's cap; replacement of an M8 effect at cap succeeds
Freed capacity is reusable by either path: stopping an aura admits a ring, stopping a ring admits an aura
